d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Muffalo: Slurp loudly. In a fight for the last bowl, slurp even louder.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_EggFrie: Yesterday's rice, today's problem, tomorrow's lunch.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PadThru: A sweet-sour tangle of noodles and crunch, wok-fired until it behaves.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ChiliCo: Hot enough to cauterize. Do not use as medicine. Do use as medicine.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_JollofR: The recipe is a fight between three colonies, all of whom are right.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_UgaliWi: Corn dough you eat with your hands, so nothing is lost when you flee.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BakedEg: Eggs that went through a lot and came out saucy.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HashBro: A potato pancake that has seen things in the drive-through.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CornFri: Fried, golden and gone before anyone remembers to share.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_PotatoG: Cream, potatoes, patience. Nothing else works that well on the Rim.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Mushroo: Stir it for twenty minutes or lose a friend. Your choice.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Steamed: Soft as a pillow, filled with something that definitely was meat.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Chocola: The reason raids get postponed by exactly one dessert.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Ceviche: Fish cooked by sourness alone, which is how most colonies work too.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Muffalo: Red, thick, and officially the unofficial national argument.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_EggFlan: Wobbles like a colonist at the end of a long shift.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BeerBat: Crunch, foam, and not a word to the neighbours.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CreamyN: A casserole that holds the colony together better than the leaders do.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Ferment: Fermented, fierce and hard to forgive. Good for the guts, they say.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RimMein: Fried noodles, wok-tossed, and exactly as healthy as it looks.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ColdPot: The potluck dish nobody planned and everybody finishes.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CreamyM: Noodles in cream, like the pasta you remember, after a few rounds of rumours.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LongPor: The recipe is a secret. The ingredient is not.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedL: Lasts all winter. So does the guilt.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CongeeO: A warm porridge for a cold, cold conscience.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_BloodBr: A dark, rich broth for the thirsty and the polite.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Hemogen: Fried until it stops looking at you.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Muffalo: Braised in beer, because the wine ran out on the second day.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ColonyP: Whatever was in the pantry, arranged with great dignity.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_NigiriP: Rice and fish, shaped by someone who should be on the front line instead.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Thrumbo: A clear broth with a very long to-do list behind it.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Biryani: Layers of rice, meat and diplomacy, sealed with a lid.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Dromeda: Slow-cooked in a clay cone, like most people wish to be.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Mushroo: Seven layers deep, and every layer has an opinion.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Lacquer: Glazed until it shines brighter than the colony's bank account.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TomYumS: Sour, spicy and will clear your sinuses and your debts.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Laksa.d: A coconut-less curry soup that does not apologize.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Tamales: Wrapped in leaves, like a gift nobody asked for.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_DimSumB: Tiny portions for tiny budgets with huge pretensions.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Chocola: Many layers, none of them honest.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GravyFr: Fries, gravy and a quiet moment of national pride.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SmokedB: Smoked for twelve hours by a man who will not talk about it.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Churros: Fried dough with a chocolate dip and no remorse.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Bibimba: Mix everything in one bowl, exactly like the colony itself.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Mongoli: Wok-fried, sweet, sticky and a bit too loud.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ColdNoo: Served so cold the noodles file complaints.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Muffalo: Sliced thin enough to read the menu through it.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Thrumbo: Raw, fierce and brave. Sign the waiver first.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_DanDanN: Spicy noodles that warn you in advance and still win.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Grilled: Smoky, sweet, and extremely hard to explain at a dinner party.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LongPor: Hand-folded, with a filling nobody asks about twice.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Strange: Sunday dinner, with a guest who did not come willingly.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Canniba: Spicy enough to hide the taste, and the thought.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Hemogen: Creamy, red and a touch too intense.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_RedStea: Practically bleating. Done exactly how a sanguophage ordered it.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Twisted: The bun twitches only slightly. Please don't tell the filling.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Muffalo: Wrapped in pastry, a tiny insulation for a very grand ego.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Boomalo: Slow-cooked in its own fat. Do not stand next to the pot.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FishThe: Creamy, gratinated and absurdly proud of itself.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Rendang: Simmered until the sauce gives up and joins the meat.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_MoleNeg: Dark, bitter and sweet: like the best advice.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Chocola: Rises like a bad rumour, falls just as fast.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CremeBr: The crust cracks under a spoon, as under pressure.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_AgaveBa: So sweet you will need a medic and a poet.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Muffalo: Creamy, rich and gone by the third spoon.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Omakase: The chef decides what you eat. You decide to be impressed.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_TeppanF: A flaming griddle, a flipping spatula and a fire extinguisher nearby.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_ClayOve: Marinated overnight, blasted in a clay oven and served with arrogance.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Churras: Meat on swords, delivered until you surrender.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Hunters: A stew that gets better every day and worse every smell.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LambKof: Spiced, shaped and served over rice like a very tasty lecture.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SevenCo: Starter, starter, starter, main, dessert, dessert and a toast.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Tartare: Served raw, because cooking is for those with something to hide.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Hemogen: Thin, red and served with a stare.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Twisted: It bubbles on its own. Nobody turned on the stove.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CheeseF: A pot of molten cheese and the rule that whoever drops the bread, pays.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Pumpkin: Orange, cheesy and decorated with a thin layer of danger.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FlourDu: Dumplings the size of fists, for people who prefer a soup with a punch.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_CheeseO: The omelette that apologizes for nothing and folds for nobody.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FruitGl: Sticky, sweet and carried to the table with oven gloves and prayers.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SushiRo: Rolled tight, dipped lightly and eaten before anyone gets ideas.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_WasabiG: It clears the nose, the throat and every previous opinion.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_Tempura: Sushi that took a wrong turn into the fryer and liked it.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HeartyW: Cooked for days over a wood-fired pot. Eat it before the pot talks back.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_LongNig: Simmered through the night by someone who had no better plans.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_StewOfQ: The stew removes any regret about the insects. The regret about the stew remains.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_SugarCo: Decorated by a colonist whose hands shake from combat, and it shows.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_FancyCu: A tiny cake with a big sprinkle problem.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_GlazedD: A ring of dough around a hole in the budget.
d:Hearth.Kitchen.DishDef/HH_Dish_HauteCu: Eight tiny plates, one giant bill.
